exposure: presence of a companion of choice
health professionals' attention, assistance, and availability during labor and birth
medical interventions (instrumental births, episiotomies, fundal pressure)
cohort: 48,039 women from 20 countries in the WHO European Region who gave birth during the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: Always having a companion of choice and receiving adequate care from health professionals were associated with a positive birth perception.
mod_finding: Instrumental births and all types of cesarean births (planned, unplanned prelabor, unplanned in-labor) were associated with less positive birth perceptions.
country: 20 countries in the WHO European Region
